result.summary: Wrote r2/lit.md addressing analysis.md's L1-L4 literature questions (overnight/intraday return attribution; free-float/share-issuance/lockup supply; vol-of-vol vs MAX vs IVOL independence; intraday timing of returns), using only pre-2023-08-08 sources found via WebSearch/WebFetch. 20 references verified true with title/author/year-month/journal/link; each literature-derived operator-language treatment is cited inline; unconfirmed items are explicitly listed under 搜不到 rather than fabricated (e.g. no literature on day_centroid/day_gini predicting returns, no systematic Lp-aggregation comparison, no verified long-only-leg number for the low-vol anomaly, no limit-up/limit-down open-price handling precedent).
